{07 02 00}Whoa!{01 00 00 0a 00} You found me,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 16 00}How's that even POSSIBLE?!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 06 00}Did my expertly-toned
glutes give me away?
messages.et:
{07 02 00}Ohoo!{01 00 00 0a 00} Sa leidsid mu,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 16 00}Kuidas see VÕIMALIK on?!{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 06 00}Kas mu meisterlikult
treenitud tagumik reetis?

messages.en:
{07 01 00}Dang it!{01 00 00 0a 00} You got me,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 15 00}You get better at this all
the time, huh? {01 00 00 05 00}What, you
got a hide-and-trainer?
{07 14 00}You could probably make a
good living doing this
professionally, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 01 00}Pagan!{01 00 00 0a 00} Sa said mu kätte,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 15 00}Sa lähed selles aina
paremaks, mis? {01 00 00 05 00}Kas sul on
peitusetreener või?
{07 14 00}Sa võiksid ilmselt selle
pealt profina head
elatist teenida, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
